name: Rex Sealing and Packing Industries Ltd

facts.business: Rex Sealing and Packing Industries Limited manufactures industrial gaskets and gland packing products used in refineries, power generation, chemical processing, food & pharmaceuticals, and other industries.

capacity_or_capex.item: New plant for manufacture of Gasket, Industrial Bellows, Chemicals at Vadgoan Taluk, Khalapur District, Raigad Maharashtra

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No Key Audit Matters Reportable as per SA 701 issued by ICAI

key_risks: Dependence on suppliers for raw materials (cost ~2/3 of revenue)
Inadequate/timely unavailability or substandard quality of raw materials
Customer concentration: large corporate houses account for ~2/3 of revenue
